comparison.objective: Insert a T-nut into an aluminium-profile slot, rotate it 90 degrees, and slide it to a mark.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-part insertion, constrained in-slot rotation, and sliding under retaining lips.
comparison.success_condition: T-nut is locked beneath the lips at the red mark and released; numeric pose and damage limits are absent.
comparison.reason: Although both involve a small recessed metal feature, this tests captive insertion and quarter-turn locking, not notch fracture by a separately hammered mandrel or fragment containment.
